notes.title: Make the game completely free
notes.notes:
Hello users.
Games that used to sell for $1 will be released for free starting December 25, 2023.
First, we would like to apologize to paid users. Refunds are available if playtime does not exceed 2 hours.
If the play time exceeds 2 hours, please contact me by email below and I will issue a refund after confirmation.

The process for freeing the game is as follows.
As many bugs were fixed and more content was added, the game developed more stably, so our goal was to secure many users.
I thought a lot about whether to release the existing game for free or not free. Nevertheless, the reason we released the game for a fee was to filter out unnecessary elements other than game testing.
The game seems to have grown thanks to the valuable feedback from paying users. thank you.

sm9901299012@gmail.com

notes.title: [EP] Problem with the game not running starting from version V1.1.0 or higher
notes.notes:
Starting with version V1.1.0 and higher, an issue where the game would not run due to missing data files has been resolved.
This was an issue that had been raised for some time, but it was happening in my work environment and I was at a loss as to what to do.
But fortunately, the cause of the problem was found and solved.
We apologize for disturbing the smooth progress of the game.

notes.title: Free For All 메이저 패치 V1.2.0
notes.notes:
[V1.2.0 Major Patch]
hello. It's really cold now. Everyone stay indoors and play games and be careful not to catch a cold.ːsteamhappyː

Um... the update is really lateːsteamthumbsdownː
The game hasn't been patched for 3 months since it was released. Because there were so many bugs and feedback.
It seems that the users' expectations were as high as my expectations for the game. However, it seems that it did not meet the expectations. So I worked harder! It's lacking, but so that it becomes less lacking!
In the meantime, users have given us a lot of feedback, including an unreadable GUI, uncomfortable controls, poor storyline, somewhat odd game progression, unpleasant experience, lack of sound, and loss of purpose. In fact, everything was true so I had nothing to say. There were so many shortcomings, perhaps because we just wanted to release it quickly and released a game with poor quality. Nevertheless, we worked hard to patch it to show an even better version. I think the most important thing is to be able to show and prove that things are changing little by little, even if everyone doesn't like it. Thank you again.ㅠㅠㅠ
This patch did our best to make the game more like a game. Although the sound patch was missing this time, we tried to improve the visual aspect of the game as much as possible, and made it possible to achieve in-game goals such as 'Quest' and 'Monster Dictionary'.
I focused on motivating myself.

[One. Bug fix]
1_1. Fixed an issue where Retracy quest status could not be updated.
1_2. [Deep Forest] [Someone's Rest] Fixed an issue where items were created in places where the 
         player could not move.
  
1_3. Fixed an issue where the UI priority was not given the highest priority when the UI displaying the 
        acquired items was displayed.

1_4. When closing the inventory UI, the item information UI is also closed. Fixed an issue where the 
        scrolling of the item information UI was not initialized at this time.

1_5. Fixed an issue where gift box type obtainable item information was displayed even after 
        reopening the store UI.
1_6. Fixed an issue where equipment item set effects in the store UI were not displayed properly.
1_7. When no items are selected immediately after opening the store UI, 'No items are selected.' Fixed 
        an issue where sentences were not displayed properly.
1_8. Fixed an issue where the buy and sell buttons disappear when clicking on a blank space in the 
         store UI.
1_9. Fixed an issue where item use and wearability in the store UI was not updated properly.

1_10. Fixed an issue where the quest update status was missing from the log UI. (The last number of 
          times was not counted)

1_11. Fixed an issue where quest progress status and completion notifications were not loaded 
          properly. (Loading issue)

1_12. Fixed an issue where the scrolling of the item information UI was not initialized properly.

1_13. Fixed an issue where stats such as current stamina and current mana were not applied properly 
          when changing items.
          example)
                         1) Change the maximum health and current health from 50 to an equipment item with 
                              lower maximum health.
                         2) Maximum health and current health are reduced to 42.
                         3) Change the equipment items back to their original state.
                         4) Maximum health 50, current health reduced to 30. - Problem occurred. Current 
                             health must be 42.

1_14. Other minor bug fixes.



[2. patch]
2_1. If the update status of a collection type quest is affected due to a lost item, it is displayed in the 
         log UI.

2_2. Added store update timer.

2_3. Quest reward button deleted. (Quest reward always displayed.)

2_4. Restricts the wearing and use of items displayed when the UI displaying the acquired items is 
         displayed.

2_5. Added pause function when outputting option UI. (Text pause)
2_6. Integration of equipment UI and ability UI.
2_7. For some UIs (10 UIs below), the UI can be closed by pressing the ESC key.
        {NPC Interaction UI},
        {Quest UI},
        {InventoryUI},
        {Equipment and ability UI},
        {Enhanced UI},
        {Shop UI},
        {Information UI},
        {Monster Dictionary UI},
        {OptionUI},
        {Boss Battle UI}

2_8. Monster Dictionary UI update status display.
2_9. Notification when the monster is first registered in the monster dictionary.
2_10. Notification when the monster unlock rate in the Monster Dictionary reaches 25%, 50%, 75%, or 100%.
2_11. Monster pre-registration notification is canceled upon user confirmation.

2_12. Improved NPC interaction UI.
2_13. 'Yellow Area 1' has been added to indicate the current options (shop, conversation, quest).
2_14. 'Yellow area 2' has been added to indicate button options (Accept/Reject buttons/Next/Previous 
           buttons/End button).
           The selection scroll changes depending on ‘Yellow Area 1’. (‘Yellow Area 1’ includes 3 options.)
2_15. You can now interact with NPCs through keystrokes. Conventional mouse clicks are also 
           possible.
           {↑: Button selection / Accept/Reject buttons / Next/Previous buttons / Exit button Up},
           {↓: Button selection / Accept/Reject button / Next/Previous button / End button down},
           {SPACE: Button selection / Accept/Reject buttons/Next/Previous button selection},
           {ESC: End NPC interaction UI}
2_16 You can now skip the dialogue script by clicking the mouse and entering keys.
          {Click on chat window},
          {Click the Accept/Reject button / Next/Previous/Finish button},
          {button margin},
	  {SPACE},
	  {ESC}

2_17. Major reorganization of the quest UI to improve readability.
2_18. The size of the quest UI has been increased by 12 times.
2_19. Quests are divided into three categories.
          {Recommended quest (unprogressed quest)},
          {Ongoing Quest},
          {Quest Completed}
2_20. You can check the details of the quest.
           {Quest performance conditions (stats, reputation, pre-quest)},
           {Quest content and status},
           {Quest rewards (stats, reputation, items)}
2_21. Quest performance conditions: Pre-quest
           {Pre-clear quest},
           {Pre-Nonclear quest},
           {Pre-progress quest},
           {Pre-Nonprogress quest}
2_22. Added 'Quest Roadmap' function that allows you to see the overall flow of the quest.
           There were linked quests and hidden quests, but considering that they were not easy to find due 
           to rare clues or lack of probability.
           You can visually check the current quest progress status
           Quest roadmap is organized by chapter
           Changes in real time depending on whether the quest is accepted, completed, or completed.

2_23. Separate icons symbolizing ability and reputation.
           Stats: Two crossed swords icon
           Reputation: Diamond shaped icon

2_24. System reorganization.
2_25. When the game ends normally, the data at the end is saved.
2_26. Save game data every minute (backup data)



[3. optimization]
3_1. Always call function -> Change to event processing.
3_2. UI improvements.
         Inventory UI, item information UI (equipment items, consumption items, other items)
				

	 
[4. Next major patch (V1.3.0) contents]
4_1. Newly revamped Quest UI bug fixes
4_2. Newly revamped NPC interaction UI bug fixes
4_3. Large-scale monster patches and additions
4_4. Added various cooldown and duration indications
4_5. Quest clear reward reorganization
4_6. Added the ability to abandon quests and turn off quest notifications
4_7. Various optimizations (object pooling, code improvements related to player ability calculation)
4_8. Add sound
4_9. language localization

notes.title: October 2023 Major Patch
notes.notes:
[b]I'm sorry![/b] I became lazy because I was so relieved that the game was released after a major patch in September.
We are currently updating to address various inconveniences over the past month since launch. Bugs are also being fixed.
Let me briefly tell you what we are doing.

[b]1. Bug fixes.[/b]
1_1. Fixed bug related to retry.
1_2. Store-related bug fixes.
1_3. Fixed bugs related to maps.
1_4. Fixed bug with item description.
1_5. Fixed bug related to stats when changing items.
1_6. Fixed bug related to gift boxes.
1_7. Various monster-related bug fixes.
1_8. Other bug fixes.

[b]2. Update.[/b]
2_1. Changes related to retry.
2_2. Store-related changes.
2_3. Changes to NPC interaction.
2_4. Added pause function.
2_5. Changes related to monster dictionary.
2_6. Cool time and duration display added.
2_7. Various monster-related changes.
2_8. Quest-related changes.
2_9. Other changes.

We will strive to become a better Free For All. thank you

notes.title: 개발자 스스로해보는 게임 리뷰
notes.notes:
hello. My game has finally been released. ːsteamhappyː
Below is a brief game review written to commemorate its release. We also discussed the future direction of the game.

Honestly, it's not fun. My goal for the second half of 2022 and the first half of 2023 was to make an RPG game. As a result, this result was obtained. I'm proud of it, but it's not fun... I hope you understand this and play the game.

This is because there are still so many things that are lacking for an RPG game. Since I do everything on my own, from planning to programming, level design, and animation, I think I understand why we collaborate.

There are over 50 improvements that will be applied in the next patch. More will continue to be added. I have to study at the same time, work on other projects, and prepare for a job, but as long as I release this game and sell it for money, I promise to take responsibility and provide continuous updates. We promise you better and richer entertainment with each patch.

Additionally, people from various countries have added my game to their wishlists and even purchased it. We are very sorry that we only support Korean, but the language localization work will likely be delayed a bit. Sorry.
Oh, and I won't do any Chinese translation. A Chinese person hacked my Steam ID a week before release. So, I got into some trouble. What a shameful guy.

Thank you.
